functional.title: Registration, roles and verification
functional.implementation_note: P03 registration, Argon2id, sessions/CSRF, receiver capacity, requested public roles and zone-admin verification pass real API/PostgreSQL checks.

functional.title: Listing creation, updates and cancellation
functional.implementation_note: Guarded listing CRUD and coordinated cancellations use real API/browser flows.

functional.title: Expiry countdown and warnings
functional.implementation_note: Server-based countdown/warning, live deadline checks and expiry worker are tested.

functional.title: Ranked matching and atomic claiming
functional.implementation_note: Ranked scoped capacity/radius feed, keyset cursors and competing idempotent claims are tested.

functional.title: Volunteer pickup and delivery
functional.implementation_note: Volunteer races, composite attempt history, pickup/delivery and deadline failures are tested.

functional.title: Participant ratings and trust score
functional.implementation_note: Completed donor/receiver ratings, eligibility/uniqueness and derived averages/counts are tested.

functional.title: Hash-linked audit ledger
functional.implementation_note: Domain/expiry/read/rating changes append canonical serialized ledgers; independent verification passes.

functional.title: Notifications including push/SMS
functional.implementation_note: Real durable in-app delivery, read state, bounded retry and expired-lease recovery work. External SMS/push is unconfigured and has no provider/device evidence.

functional.title: Scoped admin dashboards
functional.implementation_note: Zone-scoped admin review, day/zone/city aggregates and date filters use real data.

functional.title: Impact reporting by date and zone
functional.implementation_note: Picked-up and delivered mass are deduplicated; CSV matches filters; meal factor is labelled and unsupported CO2e remains null.

nonfunctional.title: ACID integrity
nonfunctional.implementation_note: Guarded command transactions, real PostgreSQL races/retries, cancellation and ledger/outbox atomicity checks pass.

nonfunctional.title: Nearby feed performance
nonfunctional.implementation_note: Actual restricted feed EXPLAIN ANALYZE captured on synthetic small data; the required 10k-listing API p95 benchmark remains P11.

nonfunctional.title: Zone availability
nonfunctional.implementation_note: Logical zone/object isolation and scoped locks are tested. Physical/shared-outage independence is deferred.

nonfunctional.title: Security and privacy
nonfunctional.implementation_note: Non-owner auth/runtime/worker logins, RLS/column privileges, CSRF/origin, Argon2id, session and workflow privacy checks pass.

nonfunctional.title: Auditability
nonfunctional.implementation_note: Canonical chain appends, concurrent serialization, independent verification and tamper detection are tested across workflow mutations.

nonfunctional.title: Multi-city scalability
nonfunctional.implementation_note: Stable multi-city zones, spatial/expiry indexes and scoped reports are implemented; large-scale and physical deployment evidence remains outstanding.
